import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize categorical labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Normalize sex and keep true missing values as NaN
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[df['sex'].isin(['nan', 'none', '']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # Convert body mass from text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    # Drop penguins with unknown sex or missing body mass
    valid = cleaned.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = valid.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2)
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
